services.title: Auto repair

reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Sherri Reyna
reviews.text: I brought my car in for brake issue and electrical issues draining my new car battery. I was told to bring the car in the day after I called. I heard nothing for 2 weeks. When I called, I was told the brake line was rusted but he hadn't gotten the car on the rack yet. The car sat there for over a MONTH! I called and asked what was going on and was given the round around. "He will get to it by the end of this week or early next week." Waited until the end of the next week and called again. I was told the car had too much rust and it would be a liability for him to try to fix it. Didn't even check the electrical issue! I called AAA to pick it up today and was told there is minimal rust and it certainly CAN be fixed. "He probably didn't want to do it. He makes his money towing." I was also told that he picks up a LOT of cars from there! See pics he took of the undercarriage. Others have said that he was probably hoping I would abandon the car there. My advice is to STEER CLEAR of Larry Hardee!!!

reviews.author: J O'Shields
reviews.text: My check engine light came on while passing through St. George on my way to the beach. I was near an auto parts store so I went in for a code read, but that didn’t work, so the associates referred me to a lady in the store who works at Larry Hardee’s. She had me follow her the short distance to the auto shop and invited my family to sit inside while they checked out my vehicle. Less than two hours later, we were fixed up (at a very fair price) and back on the road. I can’t thank Larry’s team enough for taking care of us today. As a woman with a van full of kids in a town I didn’t know, I feel they were a Godsend.

reviews.author: Leah Shulga
reviews.text: If I could give 10 stars, I would! Larry and Wesley listened to our needs and repaired my daughter's vehicle when it was no longer drivable during a road trip home after the holidays. He advised that he would take care of her as his own and 100% followed through. He even reached out to ensure she made it home safe and sound. The repair costs were reasonable, the service was well done and the care was phenomenal! Larry helped out with local recommendations and made sure she was able to get to and from the place she stayed at for the evening. There aren't many places that provide this level of customer service and care these days. If the car had to break down, St George, SC was the perfect location for the level of care and support she received at Larry Hardee's Automotive Service Center. This is above all else an establishment that we would return to and reccommend! Thank you so much for the family-like care you provided! We appreciate you!

reviews.author: Yajaira Esquea
reviews.text: I went to Larry's with a problem with my vehicle, and he treated me very well. He and his team did a good job at a very good price. But then I had an appointment for an oil change, and the lady wasn't very friendly. I felt like I was coming into the office begging for money instead of paying for service.

reviews.author: Julie Hansen-Jones
reviews.text: On a recent trip along the east coast our vehicle had a mechanical issue. We lucked upon Larry’s garage. We were so thankful to find such a knowledgeable, friendly, affordable and honest mechanic who got us repaired and back on the road as quickly as possible. Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: David R
reviews.text: On Tuesday my brother and I were driving from Baltimore Maryland to Brunswick Georgia for a funeral on the next day(Wednesday). Our car broke down and I call Larry's Hardee's 45 min before they closed. They picked us up and towed us back to their garage. I call several places to try and find a rental so we didn't miss the funeral but couldn't find one. Mr. Larry called Family Ford and secured us a last minute rental. His step son then drove us in his personal vehicle over to the Family Ford dealership where we got the rental and was back on the road in no time. We feel the great people at Larry Hardee's and Family Ford went above and beyond to help us get to the funeral while they fix our car. I'm extremely impressed with the great people at Larry's and would highly recommend them. They made a stressful hard situation so much better. Thank you very much for everything.

reviews.author: Taylor Dear
reviews.text: I brought a set of unassembled Bilstein 6112’s to the shop that I purchased for my 2016 Toyota Tundra. I didn’t want to assemble the coil springs and shocks as the normal spring compressors I could find to do the job myself are considered “widow makers/very dangerous”. I showed Wesley what I wanted done and he had it finished in 45 minutes and the shop only charged me $60 bucks. This is a great shop with honest mechanics and fair prices. Would recommend anyone to this shop!

reviews.author: Darleen
reviews.text: They treated me like family. After I accidentally pumped unleaded in my diesel, they flushed my fuel and saved my car. Made sure we were safe for our long trip home and called to check up on us. The best mechanics out there. Forever grateful, Darleen Morey

reviews.author: Claudia Hayes
reviews.text: A few weeks ago while commuting between Charlotte, NC and St. Augustine, FL, my husband was "lucky" enough to have broke down off I95 - Exit 77 in South Carolina. We were pretty sure that the old car that we were going to drive until it died was finally dead but had no idea what to do. My insurance company paid for tow with in 15 miles and after searching google and reading reviews I found Larry Hardee's. They were extremely helpful and understood the inconvenient position we were in given all of our locations, the fact it was memorial day weekend, and that it was likely the car was a goner. They even offered to contact the local Highway patrol for us to make sure we wouldn't be penalized. Long story short, the car was a goner but they graciously allowed us time to keep it there while we figured out what we were going to do. Great people at Larry Hardee's Auto Service!

reviews.author: Saiba K
reviews.text: Larry Hardee and team were fantastic. My family and I were driving to NY and out car broke down unexpectedly in SC. We needed our car to be fixed immediately and Larry Hardee was very helpful and understanding, fixing the car for us promptly! Our car has not given any trouble since. Excellent service and work product. Such great customer service truly sets this place apart!

reviews.author: gabriel mccall
reviews.text: I gave them our beat up work truck that had a bunch of problems gave me a fair price fix it all. Their secretary always knew what was going on with my truck and kept me informed. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Dee S
reviews.text: Needed a tire changed. I was able to call and give the tire size at about 8:30am. Tire was to them by 12:30p the same afternoon. Got the tire put on and out the shop by about 1:30p. Fast. Good price for the service. Friendly. I would go back and i recommend the shop.

reviews.author: Rose Nguyen
reviews.text: Mr. Larry and his shop (also family members) are godsends. We were on our way to Boston from Florida and while in stop and go traffic on I95, our car started to sputter and stall. Desperate to get off the highway and straight into a car shop we started to research near by mechanics. The first truck and tire repair shop wanted to send us to down the highway further to their alternative location. The next nearby truck repair shop recommended Larry’s Automotive and we’re so glad they did!!! Mr. Larry was able to overnight a part, graciously opened his shop on a Saturday morning to fix the car, and even transported us between his shop and motel. Before sending us off, Mr. Larry drove the car to make sure it was safe and told us to call him if anything pops us. Literally do not know where we would be without Mr. Larry and his automotive shop. Thank you so much!!!!!

reviews.author: Ryan Youngblood
reviews.text: Larry came to tow my car in personally when my family was stranded, then used his personal car to drive me back to the motel! Then they fixed our car in like 3 hours! All around great, friendly service!

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: I'm from Raleigh, NC. My vehicle broke down and I was towed into Larry's Hardee's Auto. Though they was unable to fully assist me because they were busy. Their customer service was superior. They was very kind and professional offering any assistance that there were able. If I lived in the St. George, SC area, they would be the mechanic that I would trust with my vehicles. Thanks guys! Rick Trollinger, Raleigh, NC

reviews.author: Jennifer “Electrictrixx” Hudson
reviews.text: Larry's is the best auto repair facility that I've ever come across. I live in Florida and had an accident on i95 in St. George. The officer called Larry to tow my vehicle. Not only did he tow the car but he repaired it so much that now I'm able to drive my car home. On top of that he drove across town and set me up at a tire place so that I wouldn't drive home without a spare. If you need your auto repaired I 110% recommend Larry's shop.

reviews.author: Michael Miller
reviews.text: We were travelling from Fl. to Ohio last week. We had car problems and a local business recommended this shop. Only one mechanic on duty and they dropped what they were doing and accomodated us. They went above and beyond and would highly recommend them

reviews.author: Bob Battista
reviews.text: I highly recommend this business, Everyone was very supportive and good at their jobs. I couldn't be more satisfied with the service and work i received. They got my car fixed right and quickly at a fair price.

reviews.author: Daniel Sharpe
reviews.text: We came through this town on a camping trip and our alternator died. These wonderful folks had us back on the road in under 3 hours during the hustle and bustle of the holiday season. Amazing. Thank you thank you.

reviews.author: Phil Gerber
reviews.text: My son was on his way from South Carolina to Florida to visit a friend, Who is going into the navy, Before he left. And of course had car trouble in Mr. Larry's general area, This shop towed his car and had him up and running fast to get back on the road. Thank you for taking care of my son! From one small business owner To another in South CarolinaI thank youAgain.

reviews.author: Kory Arendt
reviews.text: They got my car in quickly. I must of called a dozen places for a price quote and these guys were the best! They saved me a lot of money, I'll definitely be going back to them.

reviews.author: colby klein
reviews.text: If you find yourself in Saint George, SC needing auto repairs this is the place to go, currently waiting for our 2013 Durango needing a water pump and thermostat and they have made it very comfortable for us and our 3 kids, they put T.V on for us, allowed our kids to run around, overall they have made this unfortunate event not so unfortunate, me and my wife are extremely thankful for them. We don’t recommend any other place. Hardee’s is truly Gods Gift. Blessed. All the way from NEW YORK

reviews.author: Joann Medina
reviews.text: Great staff and experience. We got hit by a blow out and Larry’s had us up and going in less than an hour and the price can’t be beat! 100% recommended!

reviews.author: Jessica Gething
reviews.text: Was on vacation when we got a bad flat tire they got us in right away and it was fixed in 20mins and we were back on the road! Really nice people and excellent price! Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Brian Kirkman
reviews.text: Just had an AC leak fixed and even with the very extensive work that was involved with the job, they had my truck back to me within 30 hours and once again blowing cold air. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Robert Moore
reviews.text: Sixteen dollars for one gallon of gas,fifteen dollars for shop supplies ( must be the use of a gas can ),one hundred and fifty dollars for a tow of approximately twelve miles and seventy-five for diagnostic (must be looking at gas Guage and seeing it was on E).Total price two hundred fifty seven dollars and eighty seven cents. MUST BE BIDENOMICS AT ITS FINEST.

reviews.author: kay mills
reviews.text: I broke down on I 95 and found this place by accident. They treated me way better than I could have expected. Fixed my truck quick and for a very reasonable price

reviews.author: Bridget D
reviews.text: While traveling from FL to NC, I needed an emergency repair. The people here were wonderful, got the parts I needed and I was on my way! Prices were very reasonable too!

reviews.author: LESLIE DIGIACOMO
reviews.text: Ran into problems on our way from OH to FL. Larry Hardee's worked quickly to diagnose and repair our truck for a fair price and get us back on the road.

reviews.author: Lisa Carrington
reviews.text: Always a pleasure, although no one really wants to have vehicle issues. Never a bad experience with Larry and his staff!

reviews.author: Erica Garofalo
reviews.text: Very unimpressed by this company. They could not diagnose an issue that turned out to be very common and fixable. Also vehicle was left unlocked and unattended in parking lot after we trusted them with our vehicle and keys.

reviews.author: Bryan Boodhoo
reviews.text: My alternator went out on my toyota rav4, they fixed it on short notice. Thanks for being considerate.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: Great, friendly service. We were in a major bind and they went above and beyond to make sure we were well taking care of. I can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: lauren miles
reviews.text: Only place I get my car serviced at! Very nice and friendly staff. They will go the extra mile to help out

reviews.author: Arielle Morris
reviews.text: Broke down on my way out of town on vacation. and they were a big help got me in and out. So great full for this place

reviews.author: Brian Mixon
reviews.text: Very friendly atmosphere and very professional...they took care of my problems with care and professional support

reviews.author: lori lehouiller
reviews.text: We were traveling with 2 dogs and towing a camper when our truck began to have issues. We were able to bring it right over and they were able to work on it right away. It was hot and they even allowed us to have the dogs indoors while we waited. They were fair priced, and we are incredibly grateful for how quickly they were able to get us back on the road!

reviews.author: Beth Lewis
reviews.text: Hands down THE best place to take your vehicle! I called and they told me to bring my car in that day so they could take a look at it and diagnose the problem! They ordered me a tire for the next day, in and out, no problems!! Absolutely fantastic customer service! I will be going here for any car issues in the future!!
